lesson-grammar-and-structure-parallelism.quote: "She likes hiking and to swim" mixes two forms that can each follow *like*.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-parallelism.note: Like replaces enjoy and accepts either complement separately.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-parallelism.quote: In "how to install, update, and troubleshoot," one *to* can apply to all three base verbs.
lesson-grammar-and-structure-parallelism.note: Shared to is explicitly taught and endings-only checking is rejected.

lesson-grammar-and-structure-parallelism.quote: Matching form does not always mean matching visible endings.
